notes: Wild Machines' BUY MODULE and SELL MODULE, the parts shop (original scene 15; list setup 0x025a0d, input 0x024aab buy and 0x024de0 sell; questions and notices 0x022bab buy and 0x022ea6 sell). Opened from the Wild Machines menu (data/ui/wild_machines.json), which EXIT goes back to.

grid: eight cells, column by column (0x17e368): body, legs; arm weapons, colouring pattern; backpack weapons, stickers; options, EXIT. The icons slide in over 24 frames from their from_x; the chosen one is lit yellow over its plain one, pulsing while the grid takes input. The D-pad moves, wrapping (0x0df670 with flag 0x10, sys 3); confirm opens the list or leaves on EXIT; cancel jumps to EXIT. The plate 2884 waits 20 frames at -400, then slides in 20 a frame; the gears are the used SV screen's.

side: beside the grid the panel shows three pictures in turn, each 448 frames (the strip's 112 at 0.25 a frame), the next fading in over 60 frames; the strip 2882 rolls up through its window (424, 202)-(560, 298), only while the grid is up.

list: BUY MODULE lists the category's lineup on the calendar day (tables/town.json modules; tables/garage.json module_lineups), SELL MODULE the player's own (0x0182b1: the stock's parts and modules, the paints and emblems owned but the ground colour and no emblem), sorted by name. The list window pops open over 10 frames and the details windows over 12 (0x03c6fe: widening while 0.05 high, then heightening); modules use the shorter pair. Four rows 38 apart, with the maker's icon (0x1dd04c; selling, the hangar a part is fitted in, or the mark 2893 on a paint or emblem a hangar wears) and the name; arrows show more above or below. up/down move without wrapping (sys 3); X sorts by name and Y by price, again turning the order round (0x01733d); cancel goes back to the grid.

details: the chosen goods' labels (0x1dd02c by category; a module's 2868, or 2869 when it cuts lasers), their stats (data/ui/part_stats.json, right-aligned at x 560, 21 apart, from y 246 or 211 for modules, 0x03cbc3), PRICE and the price (selling, what the shop pays), and a paint's or emblem's picture (3306 or 3361 plus the entry's index) in its frame 2864. The original also turns the part's model in the details window (0x0225b0); the port does not draw it yet. grow_caps: when extra stat lines (data/ui/part_stats.json extras) make a details window taller, only the art between these rows (from the top, from the bottom) stretches: a part's window keeps its picture frame, divider and MODULE PARAMETER title (rows 117-147) whole above, a module's its title (rows 24-42); the rows between are plain sides. extra_stats part_raise and part_step (a port change): a part's window with extra lines (every leg's KNOCKBACK RESIST) would reach over the CURRENT MUSIC plate, 5 pixels below the window, with the help line 5 above it; so the window, the part's picture and its lines move up 5 and the seven lines close up from 21 to 19 apart (the labels' art squeezed with them), the window growing only 7. part_lines: more than seven lines (a weapon's second page) close up further, so the window never grows past the seven's. page_arrows (a port addition): beside the details while the goods have a second page (a weapon's hidden stats, part_stats.json details); left and right, or a click on the details, turn to it, and opening the list again starts on the first.

buy: too little money says poor; a paint or emblem already owned, owned; a part with the stock full, no_stock; otherwise the question names the part's maker (0x1dd40c: maker_0 to maker_5; modules, paints and emblems ask buy), NO chosen. YES pays (sys 27) and the part joins the stock (a paint or emblem is owned) and thanks.

sell: a part fitted in a hangar, or a paint or emblem a hangar wears, says equipped; otherwise the sell question, NO chosen. YES takes it out for sell_rate of its price (part_stats.json full_price modules, the Gold Bar, for all of it; sys 27) and says sold, the list read again. With none left, or none in the category, none, and back to the grid.
The help line shows the category's description (0x1dc5fc buy, 0x1dcccc sell) on the grid and the goods' (0x1dcc8c by kind and record; paints and emblems share one) in the list.
